name: Pagination
description: Pagination controls for paged lists (article archive, search results). Renders a `<nav>` landmark with previous/next buttons and a numbered list; supports ellipsis truncation for long page ranges.

keyboard: Tab — moves through the page links and prev/next buttons in document order.
Enter / Space — activates the focused control.
ariaRequirements: Renders a `<nav>` landmark labelled from i18n (`blogPageNavigation` → 'Page navigation' / 'Sivunavigointi' / 'Sidnavigering').
Previous/next are `<button disabled>` on the edges (still in the DOM) so the visual structure does not jump.
Chevrons and the ellipsis are `aria-hidden`; each page button carries its own `Page N` accessible name.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-28 — Bucket-1 beta port: keyboard/ARIA contract reviewed, ForcedColors story added, Storybook axe gate (parameters.a11y.test: error). 2026-07-05 (beta→stable) — re-verified independently: axe-clean across all stories in all four modes; AT snapshots refreshed compare-clean; Controls operable + 0 inert; eyeballed the pager in light and dark. Fixed two real defects: (1) the `<nav>` landmark reused the `blogPage` i18n key, so its accessible name resolved to 'Page' / 'Sivu' instead of a navigation label — added a dedicated `blogPageNavigation` key (en/fi/sv) and dropped the redundant explicit `role='navigation'`; (2) the color transitions had no `prefers-reduced-motion` guard yet reducedMotion claimed true — added `motion-reduce:transition-none`.

siblingCount.description: Number of page buttons to show on each side of current page

forbiddenUse: Remove Previous/Next on edges — keep them as disabled buttons so the visual stays stable.
Render more than ~10 page numbers inline — switch to a 'Page X of Y' label with prev/next only.
dense: Numbered pager: prev/next chevrons + sibling window w/ ellipsis; controlled (1-indexed currentPage + onPageChange); aria-current=page on active; labels en/fi/sv; null when totalPages<=1

usage.description: Pagination is the controlled pager for content collections (blog listings, search results). Hold the page in state or the URL, pass it as `currentPage` (1-indexed), and re-render from `onPageChange`. It shows first/last pages plus a `siblingCount` window around the current page with ellipsis in between, previous/next chevrons at the ends, and `aria-current="page"` on the active number. Labels come from i18next (en/fi/sv). With one page or fewer it renders nothing.

bestPractices.description: Treat it as fully controlled: update state (or the URL) in onPageChange and pass the new currentPage back down.
Sync the page with the URL (searchParams) so paginated views deep-link and survive refresh.
Tune siblingCount to available width; the default 1 keeps the row compact on mobile.
Let it self-hide: it renders null when totalPages <= 1, so no outer conditional is needed.
Do not use it for wizard steps — steps need progress semantics, not a content pager.
Do not fetch on click without updating currentPage; the active highlight and aria-current derive from props alone.
